content: The Madārij Afhām al-Afvāj is a relatively detailed commentary on Q 6:143-44 (the 'eight couples'), in two sections (exoteric, then esoteric) and seven ascending levels of interpretation, from exoteric exegetes through philosophers and Sufi verifiers to the House of the Prophet; it was edited by Najīb Māyil Haravī (1367 Sh./1988).
